title: Setup permission set, Delegated Admin Scope: no hint or one-click grant for the companion grants a delegate needs to enter Setup and pick people
body:
Filing gate ②: a maintainer ruling, carried out as child 5 of the nine that #26059's ruling (Q3) names. ⛔ Not a claim.

An admin can configure a Delegated Admin Scope on a permission set and grant the set to a user. That user then opens Setup and gets "You don't have access to this app". To act, they also need:
- the capability `setup.access`
- read access to `sys_user`, `sys_business_unit` and `sys_business_unit_member`, so the lookups can pick people and units
- CRUD on `sys_user_position`

Nothing in the scope block says so, and the docs page leaves out `setup.access`. The server is right to refuse. The gap is that the editor gives no hint and offers no fix.

Part of #26059
Ruling-ref: 6416233738 (https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/26059#issuecomment-6416233738)
Ruling: batch #396 item 1, letter Q1 是 / Q2 不做 / Q3 分拆 / Q4 框架. This card is Q3 child 5 (ui + docs, p2): item 2. Brief 6415795834, item-by-item reading 6415971852 (item 2).
Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`domain:ui#2`) · `os-steve` · session `session_01SMps7wq7rBTk53e8KTSEup`, first claimant of #26059. Domain, grade and route are triage's on first touch.

**Business reason.** Delegated administration lets a tenant hand one subtree's assignments to a regional manager. As shipped, the admin who sets it up gets a delegate who cannot open Setup and has to work out four further grants alone, by trial and error.

**Reader who acts.** The `domain:ui` execution seat, dispatch step: one os-dev, one PR on `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionAdvancedFacets.tsx` (with its i18n strings) and the docs page `content/docs/permissions/delegated-administration.mdx` in the same PR.

**Spec contract.** None changes and no key is new. The grants go into the set's existing `systemPermissions` (`packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts:1115`) and `objects` (`:1109`).

**Duplicate check.** A local scan of the 1,962 newest issues (all states, #22168–#26181) for `setup\.access.{0,200}(delegat|adminScope)` and the reverse order found 1 hit, not this (#24135, ADR-0090 D12 wording). #23323 (closed) fixed another sentence on the same docs page.

## Ruled scope (ruling Q3 item 5)

- The Delegated Admin Scope block **lists the companion grants**:
  - `setup.access`
  - `sys_user` / `sys_business_unit` / `sys_business_unit_member` read
  - `sys_user_position` CRUD
- It offers a one-click **"grant these"** that adds them to the same set: one save, no new key.
- `delegated-administration.mdx` gains `setup.access`.
- Not a server change.

## Anchors (re-read on `origin/main` `83a26c38`)

- `packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts:49`: `{ name: 'setup.access', label: 'Setup Access', description: 'Enter the Setup app shell.' }`. Holds.
- Docs file **path verified**: `content/docs/permissions/delegated-administration.mdx`.
  - The authoring example now spans `:20–40`, and its object grants are `:33–38` (`sys_user_position` CRUD, `sys_business_unit` / `sys_business_unit_member` / `sys_user` read).
  - The ruling cited `:26–36`, which has drifted. Corrected.
  - `setup.access` appears nowhere on the page.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionAdvancedFacets.tsx`:
  - The scope state and the objectui#9464 business-unit gate are at `:404–433` (the ruling's `:405–420` falls inside), with `scopeBlocksSave` at `:444–445`.
  - The block renders at `:677` ("Delegated Admin Scope" `FacetSection`). Holds.

## Expected / acceptance

- The Delegated Admin Scope block shows the five companion grants. Each is marked present or missing on the set being edited.
- "Grant these" adds only the missing ones to the same draft (`systemPermissions` gains `setup.access`; `objects` gains the reads and the `sys_user_position` CRUD), never removes or narrows an existing grant, and is saved with the set's normal Save.
- The hint and the action are hidden or inert while no scope is configured, matching the block's existing gate.
- `delegated-administration.mdx`'s example carries `systemPermissions: ['setup.access']`, with one sentence explaining why a delegate needs it.
- New strings exist in every locale the block's existing strings are in. Tests cover the present/missing state and the merge.
